title: Neumann-Lara / Škrekovski Conjecture (Conjecture 1)
statement_text: If $G$ is a planar graph, then $\vec{\chi}(G) \leq 2$.
context_text: In analogy to the Four-Colour-Theorem, this conjecture was proposed by Neumann-Lara [NL85] and independently by Škrekovski [BFJ+04]. The paper's main result (Theorem 2) shows this conjecture is equivalent to the statement that all oriented $K_5$-minor-free graphs are 2-colourable.
paper_contribution: Shows that Neumann-Lara's Conjecture is equivalent to the more general statement that every $K_5$-minor-free graph $G$ satisfies $\vec{\chi}(G) \leq 2$ and moreover any orientation of $G$ admits an acyclic 2-colouring without monochromatic triangles.
paper_title: A Note on Graphs of Dichromatic Number 2

title: Question 1
statement_text: What is the largest minor-closed class $\mathcal{G}_2$ of undirected graphs with dichromatic number at most 2?
context_text: Digraphs are loopless, without parallel or anti-parallel arcs (no 2-cycles). An acyclic colouring of a digraph $D$ with $k$ colours is a map $V(D)\to[k]$ whose colour classes induce acyclic subdigraphs; the dichromatic number $\vec{\chi}(D)$ is the minimum such $k$, and for an undirected graph $G$, $\vec{\chi}(G)$ is the maximum dichromatic number of an orientation of $G$. Since the union of minor-closed classes with $\vec{\chi}\le 2$ is again such a class, $\mathcal{G}_2$ is the class of graphs all of whose minors have dichromatic number at most 2. Neumann-Lara and Škrekovski conjectured that every planar graph has $\vec{\chi}\le2$ (Li and Mohar proved it for planar digraphs without directed triangles), and the authors show that this conjecture is equivalent to the statement that every $K_5$-minor-free graph has $\vec{\chi}\le2$ (moreover with an acyclic 2-colouring of any orientation having no monochromatic triangle); so conjecturally $\mathcal{G}_2$ contains all $K_5$-minor-free graphs. Since $\vec{\chi}(K_6)=2$ and $\vec{\chi}(K_7)=3$, $\mathcal{G}_2$ is a subclass of the $K_7$-minor-free graphs, but it seems much smaller: the authors exhibit an oriented $K_{3,3}$-minor-free graph with no acyclic 2-colouring.
